turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to fix this bug in my Node.js app. The event loop is blocking on a large JSON parse.
Have you tried streaming the JSON instead of loading it all into memory? Or maybe using a Web Worker for the heavy parsing.
Streaming sounds good. I'll look into it. Also, did you catch that talk by Steve Yegge last week?
I saw some highlights. He always has interesting takes on system design.
Yeah, really insightful. It was actually based on an essay he wrote five months prior to the talk, called 'Software Survival 3.0'.
Ah, that explains the depth. Did he go into specific coding practices in that essay?
Mostly high-level strategy, but it had some concrete advice on technical debt. Anyway, back to my bug—do you think I should switch to `JSON.parse` with a reviver function?
If the blocking is the main issue, a reviver won't help much since it still parses the whole string first. Stick with streaming or workers.
Got it. Thanks. I'll try the streaming approach tonight.
